note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list, verbatim. Guides are written in our own words from the official descriptions; where a description does not decide the steps, the guide says so instead of inventing them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableBasis: Unlocks automatically once the other 54 are earned; nothing to miss.
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks on its own. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then activities, then collectibles and cleanup — and this is the last one to pop.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableBasis: Opening mission; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this unlocks naturally at the very start of the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableBasis: Chapter completion; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing the main missions in order. Nothing optional is needed — keep following the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableBasis: Chapter completion; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Main story only — play the chapter's missions in order until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableBasis: Chapter completion; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Main story only — keep playing the chapter missions in order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableBasis: Chapter completion; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Main story only — the last chapter before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableBasis: Final mission; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It unlocks after the last chapter; the official description does not name the mission, so follow the story until the finale appears.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableBasis: Named story mission; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It comes up in the main story — play it when it appears.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableBasis: Named story mission; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Main story only.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableBasis: Named story mission; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Main story only.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableBasis: Named story mission; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Main story only.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableBasis: Named story mission; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Main story only.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableBasis: Named story mission; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Main story only.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableBasis: Completion total; nothing in the description sets a time limit.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This tracks everything the game counts toward completion — story, activities, collectibles. Treat it as the last trophy: finish the whole roadmap first, then mop up whatever the in-game completion checklist still shows.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts count whenever you pull one off while driving — jumps, near misses and airtime all feed the counter. Chip away at it during normal play, then grind the remainder with repeated jump spots once the story is done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Open the activities list in-game and sample one of each — you do not need to win or master any of them, just try them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range challenge has its own gold target — learn the weapon handling first, then clear them one by one. The counter tracks each challenge.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race — win each once.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count once each — winning the same race twice does not add to it, so work through 20 distinct race events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableBasis: Named challenge; nothing in the description sets a time limit.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — the official description names no location, so look for Cal at fishing spots once the challenge is offered.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableBasis: Any arcade game counts; no time limit in the description.
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any arcade game counts — finish a full game at any arcade machine.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableBasis: Character strand finale; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableBasis: Character strand finale; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableBasis: Character strand finale; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total across the state; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore — finish 8 full strands, not just their first missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableBasis: Character strand finale; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableBasis: Character strand finale; story progress only.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots — visit each one and meditate there. The in-game map marks spots you have used, so work through them region by region.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableBasis: Named hunt; nothing in the description sets a time limit.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt targets one specific animal — the official description does not name it, so follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, then take the shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableBasis: Collectible sets; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; completing a set means finding every card in it. Track your sets on the collectibles page and sweep one region at a time.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK photo spots are scattered across the map and each new location counts once — snap them as you travel instead of hunting them all at the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small side objectives — any 50 count, so clear the easy ones first and let the rest accumulate during normal play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: needs your partner present AND a 4-star wanted level — a combination that only lines up under specific conditions.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Do this while the conditions line up — it cannot be attempted whenever you like.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: three robberies in a row, with your partner, wanted level unbroken — one slip breaks the chain.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies in a row with your partner alongside and keep the heat on the whole time — if the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Each new vehicle you find counts once — drive or enter new models to register them. The counter climbs fastest when you try every model you pass instead of sticking to one car.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableBasis: Single-use condition; can be retried in any crowded fight.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends — pick a crowded fight and line the shots up first.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: a specific departure at VCIA — a one-off moment at the airport.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the schedule never planned. The description gives no exact method, so treat it as a one-off moment at the airport — check this guide before you leave the airport area.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: tied to the Rhinos (tanks) — a specific tank moment, not a counted total.
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. This one involves the Rhino tanks — the official description is a joke, not instructions, and what exactly counts is not confirmed in-game yet. Expect a tank encounter; watch for the moment and be ready.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableBasis: Single-attempt condition; can be retried at another jewelry store.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach: enter quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before any alarm. If spotted, the attempt fails — retry from before the robbery.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault robbery counts once you escape cleanly — plan the getaway before you go in, not after.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableBasis: Single robbery; armored trucks appear repeatedly.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take its cargo, then lose the heat — trucks run regular routes, so pick a quiet stretch.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map tracks 52 areas — visit each one until the counter completes. Fold it into your collectible sweeps so no trip is wasted.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total (9 gangs); the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs — rob one operation per gang and the counter fills. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: a specific moment — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar spot on Ocean Beach with a view and order a cocktail. Do it when you first pass through the area — it is a specific moment, not a repeatable activity.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableBasis: Single stunt; showrooms can be revisited.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a showroom's frontage to break out — pick a showroom, build speed inside, and go through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableBasis: Named location; the alley can be revisited.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The name is in the description — find the Kolt & Associates location and bowl a game there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableBasis: The description gives no steps and names no moment; flagged as unconfirmed rather than guessed.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description gives no steps — this is tied to a partnership moment in the game, and the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game. Check the in-game prompt when a partnership event appears.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: choices — and PSN tracks a count of 500. Choices are one-way once made.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The PSN counter tracks 500 — choices across the game feed it. Keep making story and side choices; the counter climbs as you decide. Remember each choice is one-way once made.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: a second attempt pays off — a moment that only triggers on a retry.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Something in the game expects a second attempt — the description gives no more than that. If a moment does not pop the first time, try the same thing again.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: a strange one-off event — the trigger is not named.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange. The description is deliberately vague — an odd event somewhere in Leonida, not yet confirmed in-game. Note where you were if something strange happens.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableBasis: From the official description: a melee drive-by — a specific action that needs the right setup.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving by, strike someone with a melee weapon equipped. Line the drive-by up deliberately — a random swing will not count.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — launder them through contacts over time until the total hits $250,000. Save your marked bills instead of spending them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts — vehicles, clothes, weapons. The counter climbs with normal spending; save the big purchases for late game and it pops on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida — each purchase counts. Buy them as your cash allows; they also store the vehicles you discover.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableBasis: Counted total; the description names no time limit.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles you own in the Scooter Bros app — any 10 count. Do it as you discover new vehicles so the two counters climb together.
